reman.title: Starter and alternator remanufacturing
reman.subtitle: Do not scrap your unit: in most cases remanufacturing costs less than buying new.

steps.title: How it works
steps.s1: Send us the number from the unit and photos — we tell you whether we can take it and what it costs.
steps.s2: Bring or ship the unit. Inspection is free.
steps.s3: We replace worn parts, reassemble and test the unit under load on a test bench.
steps.s4: You get it back with a warranty. If you cannot wait, take one from the exchange stock and return yours later.

reman.formHint: Give the number from the unit’s plate and the make and model of the machine. If the number is illegible, describe the machine and we will find it.
